2608.28308.title: Deriving Scaling Laws for OpenEuroLLM Models: Learning Rate, Batch Size and Loss
2608.28308.paper_summary: We study the scaling behavior of learning rate and batch size in pretraining dense large language models on English-prevalent corpora. Beyond scaling \textit{jointly optimal} learning rates and batch sizes, we investigate their \textit{marginal} evolution with model capacity and data scale and develop a model that captures these relationships. As we employ a Warmup-Stable-Decay learning rate schedule, we further investigate the gains from learning rate annealing over a broad range of hyperparameters settings, models and data budgets, and whether the optimal learning rate and batch size \textit{transfer} between the stable and decay phases. Finally, we characterize the dependence of loss on model capacity and dataset size, evaluating recently proposed scaling forms that explicitly model their interaction. We find these approaches particularly effective at capturing both undertraining and overtraining regimes across our experiments. This study establishes a first baseline and scaling procedure for the development of future OpenEuroLLM models. We open-source the complete collection of pretraining runs used in this study.
2608.28308.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究在以英語為主的語料庫上預訓練密集大型語言模型時學習率和批次大小的縮放行為。除了縮放\textit{共同最佳}的學習率和批次大小外，我們還調查它們隨著模型容量和數據規模的\textit{邊際}演變，並開發了一個捕捉這些關係的模型。由於我們採用了Warmup-Stable-Decay學習率計劃，我們進一步調查在廣泛的超參數設置、模型和數據預算下，學習率退火所帶來的收益，以及最佳學習率和批次大小是否在穩定和衰減階段之間\textit{轉移}。最後，我們描述損失對模型容量和數據集大小的依賴性，評估最近提出的明確建模其互動的縮放形式。我們發現這些方法在捕捉我們實驗中的欠訓練和過度訓練模式方面特別有效。本研究建立了未來OpenEuroLLM模型開發的第一個基準和縮放程序。我們將本研究中使用的完整預訓練運行集開源。
